# Relay stage 1: Ideate
Task: live-card-progress-and-succinct-stage-label
Working directory: /Users/admin/Dev/temp-visual-relay

## Task input
# Make the queue card's progress live and its running-stage label succinct

Two card defects observed by the maintainer during a real run, both diagnosed in source:

1. **The progress bar only moves on Refresh.** The card binds
   `ProgressFraction => Math.Clamp(Task.CompletedStageCount / 12.0, 0, 1)`
   (src/VisualRelay.App/ViewModels/TaskRowViewModel.cs:103). `CompletedStageCount` comes from
   `RunMetrics` attached when the task LIST is loaded from disk
   (src/VisualRelay.Core/Tasks/RelayTaskRepository.cs:243-253, RunMetrics.CompletedStageCount =
   Stages.Count of the last recorded run) — so during a live run the value is frozen (and on a
   task's FIRST run it is 0 throughout). Stage events during the run call
   `TaskRowViewModel.MarkRunning(...)` but nothing recomputes the fraction, `UpdateTask(...)`'s
   notification list omits `ProgressFraction`, and the `12.0` denominator is a hardcoded stage
   count. Net effect: the bar looks static/absent until a full task-list reload (the Refresh
   button) republishes metrics.
2. **The running-status line grows into an unreadable "Stage 01 & Stage 02 & Stage 03 & …".**
   `MainWindowViewModel.LiveState.cs:157` does `_runningStageNumbers[taskId].Add(stageNumber)` on
   every stage START and never removes entries when a stage completes — the set is "every stage
   that has ever started this run", not "stages running now". `RunningStepLabel`
   (TaskRowViewModel.cs:66-70) then joins the WHOLE set with `" & "` as soon as Count > 1 and
   drops the stage NAMES entirely; the card clips it with `TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"`
   (QueuePanel.axaml MetricsLine block). The multi-entry form was presumably meant for the
   genuinely concurrent Review ∥ Visual-review pair (stages 7+8), which is the only legitimate
   concurrency in the pipeline.

Note: `report-review-pair-stages-independently` (landing just before this task) makes each pair
stage publish its own completion — consume those per-stage signals here; do not re-derive pair
state.

## What to build

1. **Live progress.** Track per-running-task completed-stage count in the view-model layer from
   the same stage lifecycle events that drive `UpdateRunningStage`/stage completion, and have the
   card's fraction prefer the LIVE count while the task is running (falling back to the last-run
   `RunMetrics` when idle). Notify `ProgressFraction` on every stage completion (and include it in
   `UpdateTask`'s notification list). Derive the denominator from the actual pipeline stage list
   (`RelayStages`) instead of the literal `12.0`, counting Skipped stages as progressed so the bar
   still reaches full on runs with skipped stages.
2. **Truthful running set.** Remove a stage from `_runningStageNumbers[taskId]` when that stage
   completes (Done/Skipped/Flagged), so the set means "in flight right now". After this, the
   multi-entry case can ONLY be a genuinely concurrent group.
3. **Succinct label.** Redesign `RunningStepLabel`:
   - Single stage (the overwhelmingly common case, unchanged shape): `Stage 07 · Review`.
   - Concurrent stages: one compact segment such as `Stages 07+08 · Review ∥ Visual-review` —
     numbers joined with `+`, names joined with `∥` (or a similarly compact separator), never the
     unbounded `" & "` chain, and never nameless numbers. Completed stages are the progress bar's
     job — the label must never enumerate them.
   - Keep `Starting task` / `Planning…` behaviors as they are.
4. No new bindings/markup complexity in QueuePanel.axaml beyond what the label/fraction changes
   require; MaxLines/trimming stay as a safety net, but the designed content must fit a typical
   card width without relying on it.

## Tests (red first)

- Stage-completion event removes the stage from the running set: drive start(7), start(8),
  complete(8) → label shows `Stage 07 · Review`; complete(7) → label leaves the multi form.
- Concurrent form: start(7)+start(8) → label matches the compact pair format (numbers + names,
  no " & ").
- Live fraction: sequence of stage completions raises `ProgressFraction` monotonically WITHOUT
  any task-list reload, with PropertyChanged raised for `ProgressFraction` each time; idle rows
  fall back to RunMetrics-derived fraction.
- Denominator: fraction uses the RelayStages count (assert full bar when all stages incl. a
  Skipped one are done), not 12.0 (guard against the literal reappearing).
- `UpdateTask` notifies `ProgressFraction`.

## Verification

- `./test.sh` fully green including the new tests.
- Ledger note: with a real (or simulated) run, the card's bar visibly advances at stage
  boundaries with no Refresh click, and the running label never exceeds the pair form.

Based on the detailed descriptions (the filesystem is outside `.swival/` scope, so I'm working from the thorough problem description you provided), here is my analysis and solution options.

---

## Analysis

There are **two defects** rooted in the view-model and state-tracking layers, and the fix touches three aspects: progress tracking, running-stage set management, and the label renderer. The task input gives extremely detailed line-level context, so I can frame options concretely despite not reading the source.

### Defect 1: Frozen progress
- `CompletedStageCount` is sourced from `RunMetrics` (disk-snapshot), not from live in-memory stage events.
- `12.0` is hardcoded instead of using the actual pipeline stage count.
- `ProgressFraction` is never notified during `MarkRunning` / stage-completion paths.

### Defect 2: Unbounded running-stage set
- `_runningStageNumbers` is append-only (adds on start, never removes on completion).
- The label joins the whole set with `" & "`, producing unreadable chains.

---

## Solution Options

### Option A: Separate live counter + reactive label (recommended)

Introduce a mutable `_liveCompletedStageCount` on `TaskRowViewModel` that gets incremented on every stage-completion event (Done/Skipped/Flagged). `ProgressFraction` then becomes a derived property:
- If task is running: `_liveCompletedStageCount / RelayStages.Count` (skipped stages count as progressed).
- If idle: the existing `RunMetrics.CompletedStageCount / RelayStages.Count`.

`_runningStageNumbers` is modified to remove entries on stage completion (not just start). The label becomes a computed string that switches on cardinality of the running set.

**Pros:** Clear separation of concerns (live vs. persisted), minimal new state, fits naturally into existing event flow. Tests map 1:1 to the described scenarios.

**Cons:** Need to ensure `_liveCompletedStageCount` resets properly between runs of the same task row.

### Option B: Reactive pipeline using a per-task stage tracker

Introduce a `RunningStageTracker` helper object per running task that maintains both `_completedStageIndices` (for the fraction) and `_runningStageIndices` (for the label). Both are `ObservableCollection`-like, and the card reacts via bindings. The tracker subscribes to the stage lifecycle events and self-resets on task start.

**Pros:** Very clean separation — the view-model delegates all live-stage bookkeeping. Easy to unit-test independently.

**Cons:** More ceremony (new class, DI wiring or factory), somewhat over-engineered for what amounts to a counter and a small set. Risks being harder to review than Option A.

### Option C: Inline fix with a computed re-evaluation pass

Keep the existing `RunMetrics`-based fraction but add a post-stage-completion hook that recomputes `ProgressFraction` from the live `_runningStageNumbers` set (i.e., fraction = "stages that are no longer in the running set" / total). Fix the denominator to use `RelayStages.Count`. Remove from `_runningStageNumbers` on completion. Derive the label the same way.

**Pros:** Minimal structural change — no new fields. Reuses existing data structures.

**Cons:** Conflates two semantics (running set vs. completed set) into one source of truth, which is error-prone (e.g., a skipped stage is never "running" so it'd look completed before it starts). The implicit "completed = total - running" breaks if a task starts but hasn't had all stages registered yet. Less testable.

---

### Recommendation

**Option A** best matches the task description's requirements:
- "Track per-running-task completed-stage count in the view-model layer" → the `_liveCompletedStageCount` field.
- "Derive the denominator from the actual pipeline stage list" → `RelayStages.Count`.
- "Remove a stage from `_runningStageNumbers[taskId]` when that stage completes" → the set fix.
- "Redesign `RunningStepLabel`" → switch on set size (0 → "Planning…", 1 → single form, 2+ → pair form).

The four test scenarios (completion-removes-from-running-set, concurrent label, monotonic fraction, denominator correctness) all map directly to this approach.

The fix needs to add a mutable live-completed-stage counter, remove entries from the running set on stage completion, derive the fraction denominator from the actual pipeline stage list (RelayStages), redesign the label for single-stage (Stage 07 · Review) and genuinely-concurrent-pair (Stages 07+08 · Review ∥ Visual-review) forms, wire PropertyChanged notifications for ProgressFraction, and write red-first tests covering all of the above.",
